item.title: Style: Lessons in Clarity and Grace
item.description: Paragraph state your aim before giving the reasons for it When you explain a new game to someone, do you tell them the rules/strategies and then the objective, or vice versa? Which sounds more logical to you: S1 or S2? S1. You need to develop a strategy, make decisions as to whether to collaborate or not with the other players, also keep an eye on the progress of the other
